Description: Shared account QC_Analyst used by all six analysts; audit trail cannot attribute integration changes to a person
Root Cause: Legacy setup never migrated to named accounts after system install
Corrective Action: Issue unique named accounts to all analysts; disable shared account
Preventive Action: Add unique-account verification to quarterly access review; prohibit shared credentials in SOP-QA-021
Effectiveness Check: Next quarterly access review shows 100% named accounts; AT sampled for 10 batches shows person-level attribution

Description: No audit-trail review in second-person data review; 12 manual integrations without reason codes in 5 sampled sequences; 2 failing RS results reprocessed to pass
Root Cause: Data-review SOP predates audit-trail review expectation; reviewers trained on printouts only
Corrective Action: QA impact assessment of the 2 reprocessed results; issue manual-integration policy with mandatory reason codes
Preventive Action: Add audit-trail review to data-review SOP checklist; retrain all reviewers
Effectiveness Check: Next 20 sequences show 100% reason-coded integrations and documented AT review

Description: Nightly backup runs but no restore test has ever been performed; backup is the only copy of project data
Evidence Ref: EV-2026-016 (backup log; no restore records found)
Root Cause: Restore verification never added to IT qualification schedule
Corrective Action: Perform and document a restore test to an isolated environment
Preventive Action: Schedule restore tests every 6 months; file results in IT qualification record
Effectiveness Check: Next scheduled restore test completed on time with verified data readability

Description: 6 of 20 sampled corrections missing date or reason; 3 blank fields not ruled through with N/A
Root Cause: Error-correction rule not reinforced after onboarding; form design lacks blank-field instruction
Corrective Action: Correct affected entries per GDP where permissible; re-brief analysts on correction rule
Preventive Action: Add correction-rule refresher to annual GDP training; revise form to prompt N/A for unused fields
Effectiveness Check: Next 20 corrected entries sampled: 100% carry initial, date, and reason

Description: Unvalidated local copy of assay calculation spreadsheet on analyst desktop; formula for dilution factor edited vs. validated master
Root Cause: Master copy not access-restricted; no prohibition on local copies in spreadsheet SOP
Corrective Action: Remove local copies; verify affected batch calculations against validated master
Preventive Action: Restrict master to read-only controlled location; add annual formula re-verification to SOP-QC-047
Effectiveness Check: Annual re-verification shows zero drift between live files and validated master

Description: Ex-employee account still active on instrument PC; balance printouts not consistently reconciled against logbook entries
Evidence Ref: EV-2026-019 (user list vs. HR list; logbook sample)
Root Cause: De-provisioning step missing from leaver process for standalone equipment
Corrective Action: Disable orphan account; reconcile last 3 months of printouts against logbook
Preventive Action: Add standalone-equipment accounts to leaver checklist; monthly printout-to-logbook reconciliation
Effectiveness Check: Next monthly reconciliation shows zero unmatched printouts; next access review shows zero orphan accounts
